prompt: Write a list of 25 animated films from the 2000s, in the following format: “[TITLE] ([YEAR]), by [DIRECTORS]”. Do not write any descriptions or sort in chronological order. The titles must be listed randomly, not in any order.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 best follows the prompt by listing 25 animated films with the required “Title (Year), by Directors” format and keeping (nearly all) entries within the 2000–2009 range, with only minor director-list omissions. Candidate 2 and 3 each violate the core constraint that the films must be from the 2000s by including titles outside 2000–2009 (e.g., LEGO Movie 2014; Kubo 2016 and The Illusionist 2010), and they also have director-detail inaccuracies. Candidate 4 most severely breaks the formatting/no-extra-text requirement by embedding correction commentary directly in the list and also includes clearly out-of-range years, making it the least compliant.
